summary: This is an 8-K filed by Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, reporting shareholder approval to extend the deadline to complete a business combination from June 6, 2026 to June 6, 2027 via up to twelve monthly extensions, each requiring a deposit of $0.033 per public share (up to $60,000 per extension). The trust agreement was amended accordingly. This is a routine SPAC extension filing that does not signal a definitive merger agreement, termination, or other special-situation catalyst. No deal terms, premium, or break fee are involved. Watch for future announcements of a target business combination or liquidation if no deal is struck.
